design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (immunization_appointments, category vax). Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[6, 6, 6, 4]; the booking (root), the invalidation and the course opening take 6 factors each, the consent form takes 4.
SCOPE SNAPSHOT: task 0 is the first task; nothing is occupied. It claims the resumed-series chain: vax_ext_dose_invalidation_balance (invalidate_series_dose_51b39017), vax_ext_resumed_course_opening (open_resumed_course_fd79a681), vax_ext_resumed_dose_consent (sign_dose_consent_2c77f168, owner user) and vax_ext_series_dose_booking (book_series_dose_9b68cabc, root). Left for task 1 (draw: 1 prerequisite problem, factors [5, 6]): the dose record posting and the patient's settlement of a dose charge (vax_dose_administered money and observation), untouched here.
WHY A GOOD TEST: the caller asks only to book 'the one shot she is short'. Reaching the right booking needs four writes discovered from policy: the outside dose 3 of 2026-08-01 is too early (103 days after dose 1 < 112 - 4) and must be invalidated; her only hepatitis B course is cancelled, so the series resumes on a new course whose opening balance credits earlier doses by ledger rules; the booking waits on a signed form that only she can sign; and the booking date is a six-factor computation. The difficulty is ledger reconciliation (five dose entries of four kinds: Kestrel dose, registry copy, documented outside dose, undocumented report, too-early dose), rule reading and arithmetic, not tool guessing.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root vax_ext_series_dose_booking. Edges: (1) booking -> consent form, state_gate, gate vax_events.event_type, state form, sentence 'An appointment for the next dose of a series is not booked until a screening and consent form for that dose stands signed on the open course of the vaccination.' [negated direction; resolved by sign_dose_consent_2c77f168, owner user]; false at opening: the only form (K1) covers dose 2 of the cancelled course. (2) booking -> invalidation, value_input, gate series_clock_days, state form, sentence 'Before the days ahead of that appointment are fixed, every dose on the series history given sooner than its minimum interval less the grace period must carry its invalidation entry.'; false at opening: D3 has no invalidation entry. (3) consent -> opening, state_gate, gate vax_evt_dose_administration.dose_on_open_course, sentence 'The dose number a form covers is set only once the resumed course of the vaccination stands open on the patient's profile with its opening doses still needed.'; false at opening: course A is cancelled. (4) opening -> invalidation, value_input, gate outside_credit, sentence 'A resumed course's opening doses still needed are fixed only after every dose found too early on the earlier course carries its invalidation entry and the earlier course's valid doses still needed are restated.'. Exactly one write of this difficulty books an invalidation entry (invalidate_series_dose_51b39017), opens a course (open_resumed_course_fd79a681) and records a signed form (sign_dose_consent_2c77f168), so each state-form sentence resolves to one action. Four-point test: each sentence has an ordering connective (not until / before / only once / only after), names a record-visible state, names no tool, id or code token, and states a hard requirement at the edge's scope. Directions: the booking and the form use the negated or 'only once' form a desk uses for a release ('not booked until'), the balance uses 'fixed only after' as for a figure. Topological order: invalidation (step 8), opening (10), form (12), booking (14). Deletion sensitivity (Step 5 run): skipping the invalidation moves the opening balance from 1 to 0 and the booking's days ahead from 7 to 8; skipping the opening leaves no open course for the form and the appointment; skipping the form forbids the booking.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: step 8 vax_evt_invalid_dose.invalidate_once (no invalidation row exists for D3). Step 10 vax_agg_multi_holding (no course of the vaccination scheduled or in progress: A is cancelled), vax_agg_visit_and_season (not seasonal, no dose today), vax_course_eligibility (age 44 within 18..120; repeat_course_allowed false but no completed course exists; the risk-condition gate is superseded by the declared overwrite 'A resumed course takes the patient's risk condition attestation as recorded on the earlier course...', and hepatitis B has risk_condition_required_below_age 0), vax_course_closure (earlier and outside doses count on the new course). Step 12 vax_evt_dose_administration.dose_on_open_course (course opened at step 10 is scheduled). Step 14 vax_evt_booking.book_on_open_course (scheduled course) and one_open_appointment (the new course has no appointment). No time gate applies to these subjects (consent_current and dose2_interval govern dose administration only); the booking lands 2026-10-01, day 7 of a form signed 2026-09-24 with 7-day validity: the dose on that day is within the inclusive boundary, one day later would not be.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: the object is the hepatitis B series of Rosalind Sato, history on course A (cancelled). Entries: O1 documented outside dose 1 (stands), D0u undocumented dose 1 report (set aside), D2k Kestrel dose 2 (stands, reported R1, paid claim clm1), D2r registry copy of D2k (plan-billed, no store; set aside), D3 outside dose 3 (too early; invalidated at step 8). The invalidation names D3 by source_event_id; the resumed course is a new object keyed by its returned course_id; the form and the booking name that course.
FACTOR CARD. Invalidation (result 1): counted_history method (closed + reported -> every entry, 5; baseline reported only 1 -> 3); registry_copy method (D2r plan-billed, Kestrel reported -> 1; baseline 0 -> 0); found_dose parameter (D3 too early, no store -> found_entries_outside 1; baseline 0 -> 0); outside_first_dose method (D0u has no lot -> only it set aside; baseline all dose 1 outside entries 2 -> 2); after_closing parameter (after_close_set_aside_reported 0; baseline sets D3 aside twice -> 2); restatement_way method (rebuild; baseline shown 2 + 1 -> 3). Near-miss: dose 2 came 28 days after dose 1, the nominal minimum interval (valid; the grace floor is 24 days), while dose 3 is the invalid one. Opening (result 1): carry_scope method (closed 106 days <= 365 -> carry all; baseline nothing -> 3); credit_window parameter (span 103 days -> 600 months; baseline 0 -> 3); kestrel_dose_credit method, cross-difficulty coverage (1 reported, 1 paid claim -> 1; baseline 0 -> 2); outside_dose_credit method (2 documented less 1 invalidation -> 1; baseline 0 -> 2); copy_credit_rule parameter (0; baseline 1 -> 0); undocumented_credit_rule parameter (0; baseline 1 -> 0). Consent (result 3): numbering_continuation method (baseline 1), repeat_numbering method (baseline highest number + 1 = 4), copy_positions_rule parameter (baseline 4), unlotted_positions_rule parameter (baseline 4). Booking (result 7): next_dose_clock method (repeat clock 56 - 54 = 2; baseline standard 1 -> 6); missed_visit parameter, multi-source (1 no-show + cancellation -> 1; baseline -> 6); plan_check parameter, cross-difficulty coverage, multi-source (Commercial Copay Plan not government, 1 rejection 2026-08-27 in 3 months -> 1; baseline -> 6); resumed_series parameter (closed 106 days -> 2; baseline -> 5); outside_record parameter (-> 1; baseline -> 6); allowance_combination method (closed course: sum 5; baseline none -> 2). Whole baselines: invalidation 3, opening 3, consent 1, booking 1, all different from gold.
RULE <-> COMPUTE: every binding that reads the world or branches quotes its rule sentences in compute_basis (e.g. series_clock_days quotes the three clock sentences, combined_allowance the three combination sentences and 'The combined allowance is added to the days ahead after the one-day-ahead rule and before the booking window is applied.'); in reverse, every sentence carrying a count, window, cap or order is claimed (the 12-month no-show window -> within_months=12; the 3-month rejection window -> within_months=3; 'never below zero nor above the valid doses the course requires' -> MX/MN; 'one day ahead' -> MX(1, ...); 'booking window' -> MN(30, ...)).
SEED ROLES: customer, store 04317 and the Commercial Copay Plan are the locating and billing parents; clm1 (paid 2026-05-18) drives the Kestrel-dose credit, clm2 (rejected 2026-08-27) drives the plan-check allowance; course A with its 12 ledger rows carries every factor's evidence. Deleting D2r removes the copy factor's effect, deleting D0u the undocumented rules', deleting N0 the missed-visit allowance, deleting clm2 the plan-check allowance. No automatic clause fires: A is cancelled so no auto-booking or registry deadline is pending (R1 reported D2k within 3 days), one no-show is below the suspension limit of 2, and the coverage rows carry no pending obligation.
PERSONA: a brisk project coordinator; volunteers only the goal (one shot short, book the earliest allowed date at 10:30 at Sawmill Parkway) and the natural situation (shots started there, one shot at an out-of-state clinic on August 1st, the nurse's remark). Given when asked: phone 2065550418 and DOB 1982-03-21 for verification, email/ZIP only if more is needed, store number 04317, unchanged Buckeye Benefit Rx card (member ID only if asked), 'no' to immunocompromise, risk condition and allergy. Passive: agrees to record changes, signs the handed-over form as the patient, repeats the date and ends. She never names a prerequisite, never corrects a figure, never asks for anything beyond the booking.
REACHABILITY: every value is reachable at its step: A, D3 and the store from find_vax_courses/find_vax_events, the plan from find_coverage_plans, the claims from find_coverage_claims, the new course id from the opening's return (step 10), dose 3 from the form's return (step 12), 10:30 from the persona. All four writes are synchronous under frozen_time 2026-09-24 10:40 EDT; nothing waits on a real-world event (the outside dose and the invalid timing already happened).
STANDARD SOLUTION AND RECOMPUTATION (harness over the real tools, the gate's own evaluator): invalidation doses_remaining=1, opening doses_remaining=1, form dose_number=3, booking days_ahead=7 (2026-10-01 10:30). Gates run per task: check_extended, check_task_tools, replay_tasks, check_solvability, check_compute, check_grounding, check_cross_fire all OK for --task 0.
DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT: reading only the policy prose, tool schemas, the find_* returns and the persona, the booking rule's two prerequisite sentences send the agent to the form rule and the invalidation rule; the form rule's sentence sends it to the opening rule; the opening rule's sentence sends it back to the invalidation. The same four figures follow from the prose alone; no hidden asset is needed.
REVISIONS: (1) symptom: skipping the invalidation left the booking at 7; root cause: the outside-record allowance fell from 1 to 2 while the clock rose; change: allowance_outside_unreviewed set to 3; re-run: booking without the invalidation = 8. (2) symptom: check_extended 'only 1 effect=parameter factor' on the invalidation; change: the after-closing rule selects after_close_set_aside_reported; re-run OK. (3) symptom: the base risk-condition gate cannot be evidenced for a resumed course; change: the opening policy declares an overwrite taking the attestation from the earlier course.
REVISION ROUND 2 (policy-task audit findings F-1..F-11, T0-1..T0-6): (F-1/T0-2) the invalidation policy now declares its overwrite of base 'An invalid dose does not count toward the course: the course needs one more dose' by the rebuild sentence; (F-2/T0-1) the booking policy declares its overwrite of base 'which is given no earlier than the invalid dose's date plus the same minimum interval' by the repeat sentence naming the interval separating the invalid dose from the dose before it, and the repeat clock now also keeps the dose 3 interval from dose 1 (MX(2, -49) = 2, result unchanged 7); (F-3) the dose 1 rule reads 'Kestrel gave a later dose at one of its stores' and the compute counts Kestrel-given dose 2 and dose 3 entries; (F-4) the opening's carry sentence no longer says 'and nothing else'; (F-7) the opening declares its overwrite of base vax_course_closure's crediting clause; (F-5) where the earliest date lies beyond the booking window no appointment is booked today, and the window caps only earliest date plus allowance; (F-6) consent numbering mode 1 now covers the dose after the doses Kestrel reported; (F-8/F-9/F-10) the after-closing, copy and undocumented ladders are partitioned by documentation or Kestrel report, so every fall-through selects a count distinct from the other tiers wherever it applies; (F-11/T0-6) the missed-visit allowance weighs no-shows only; (T0-4) every factor_sensitivity.tier_taken is now recomputed from the world; (T0-5) after_closing traced as parameter. Re-run: invalidation 1, opening 1, form 3, booking 7; per-factor baselines unchanged.
user_scenario: You are Rosalind Sato, 44, a project coordinator who talks quickly and plainly and would rather get something booked than hear a long explanation. You got your first hepatitis B shot at a clinic in April and your second one at the Kestrel Sawmill Parkway store in Powell in May, then took a temporary work assignment out of state over the summer and got one of the shots at a clinic there on August 1st. You are back home now, and the occupational health nurse at your new job looked over your records and told you that you are still one shot short of finishing the series. You are calling to book that shot at Kestrel, at the same Sawmill Parkway store, on the earliest date you are allowed to have it; you would like a 10:30 slot and any weekday is fine. You are happy for the representative to do whatever needs doing on the records to get you booked, and you will do anything that has to be done by you personally while you are on the phone. When the representative asks who you are, you give your mobile number, 2065550418, and your date of birth, March 21, 1982 (1982-03-21); only if they ask for more do you give your email, rosalind.sato@lumenmail.com, or your ZIP code, 43065. If they ask which store, it is Sawmill Parkway, store number 04317 on your old appointment card. If they ask about insurance, you still have the same Buckeye Benefit Rx card that is on file and nothing has changed; you read the member ID, 4K77190235, only if they ask for it. If they ask whether you have a weakened immune system, a qualifying health condition, or any allergy or reaction to vaccines, the answer to each is no. If they ask about the clinic shot, you only remember it was August 1st and that the clinic said it would send the record to the state registry; you do not have the paper with you. You do not know anything about how Kestrel keeps its records, and you do not suggest any steps. If the representative explains that something has to be put right or set up on your records before they can book you, you tell them to go ahead. If the representative tells you there is a form or step you must complete yourself and hands it to you, you complete it as yourself, the patient, and then tell them it is done. When the representative gives you the appointment date and time, you repeat the date back once, thank them, and end the call. If they offer a date without saying why, you accept it; you never ask for a different date and you never ask for anything else.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_event_id: Value 11a56980-fc96-4fd4-be2b-cdb045dcf303. Basis: the invalidation policy's rule 'Where the latest dose on record came too early, meaning ... dose 3 ... less than the dose 3 minimum interval from dose 1 less the grace period days after dose 1'; this entry is dose 3 of 2026-08-01, 103 days after dose 1 of 2026-04-20, below 112 - 4 = 108. argument_uniqueness_tracing.is_final_dose: Value false. Basis: the entry itself records is_final_dose false and the course was cancelled, never completed; docstring 'false when it did not complete the course'. Unique: true would claim the dose completed a course that the record shows cancelled.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.doses_remaining: Value 1. prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The graph is a chain with one diamond: booking depends on the form and on the invalidation, the form on the opening, the opening on the invalidation. The only topological order is invalidation, opening, form, booking; no two writes are free to swap, because the opening needs the invalidation entry, the form needs the open course, and the booking needs the form.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the form the appointment may not be booked (state gate): a correct agent does not write the booking row, so the terminal state lacks both the consent row and the appointment row.
Skipping the invalidation: the booking's clock falls to the standard (1 day ahead) and the outside-record allowance becomes 3, so days_ahead is 8 instead of 7.
Without the resumed course there is no open course to carry the form or the appointment; the consent and booking rows land on no open course and the course row is missing from the terminal state.
Skipping the invalidation: the outside credit is 2 instead of 1, so the resumed course opens with 0 doses still needed instead of 1.
